text:
john_acme: Hey team — we started getting 403s in our nightly job when the client tries to do a combined embeddings+generation flow. Worked yesterday. Error: "403 Forbidden: missing permission: inference.generate". Full curl and headers pasted below.

lina_cs: Sorry about that — can you paste the request id from the response and the `x-tenant-id`? Also, did you recently rotate keys / SSO? :thinking_face:

john_acme: request id = req_20260317_6bfa; tenant = acme-enterprise. We did a slow rotation yesterday via the SSO provisioning UI — but rollout targeted only some k8s workers.

lina_cs: ok noted. Can you paste the minimal repro (curl) — that'll speed triage.

john_acme: sure —
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXX"
 -H "Content-Type: application/json"
 -d '{"tenant":"acme-enterprise","requests":[{"type":"embedding","model":"embed-lite","input":"q1"},{"type":"generate","model":"redwood-1","prompt":"hi"}]}'
```

sean_oncall: pinging the provisioning audit now. @provisioner_bot can you spool the last change for tenant=acme-enterprise? :eyes:

provisioner_bot: audit_result: change_id=chg_882; actor=svc-sso-provisioner; action=rotate_keys; scopes_assigned=[embeddings.create]; notes="canary rollout to 20% nodes"

lina_cs: aha — the provisioning change shows only embeddings scope was applied to the new key. That would explain the 403 for inference.generate. Did the customer request a restricted key?

john_acme: not intentionally. Our infra automation did a partial rollout and we thought it was transparent. We have a fallback until we fix.

marta_infra: adding context — we observed a config bug in the SSO transformer where CSV claims parsing dropped comma-separated scopes when length > 64 chars. For tenants with long scope lists we saw truncated claims, resulting in only the first scope being persisted. Repro steps in staging: 1) provision svc key with scopes `embeddings.create,inference.generate,rerank.score` 2) run transformer -> manifest shows `embeddings.create` only.

sean_oncall: Thanks @marta_infra. Action plan: Lina will guide customer to repro and rotate to a full-scope key via the admin console; Marta will push a hotfix to the transformer and we will roll it to prod canary; I opened INC-ACME-4721 to track the tenant impact and mitigate.

lina_cs: John — quick mitigation: generate a new API key from Admin > Service keys and ensure the "Scopes" box includes: `embeddings.create`, `inference.generate`, `rerank.score`. If you prefer CLI we can issue a temporary full-scope key for you. Once you confirm the new key works we'll mark as resolved.

john_acme: I created a new key and pasted it into the job — success: both embedding and generate steps returned 200. Thanks! :tada: Please let me know when the transformer fix is live so we can resume normal rotations.

marta_infra: hotfix PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/provisioner/merge_requests/891. Will deploy canary in 30m, monitor claims length metric.

sean_oncall: marking incident INC-ACME-4721 as "mitigated" pending patch rollout. Lina will follow up with postmortem and customer note.

lina_cs: Follow-up notes for customer: root cause = SSO provisioning transformer truncated long scope claim lists during rotation, resulting in keys missing `inference.generate` and `rerank.score`. Mitigation = rotate to new full-scope key or use temporary full-scope key; long-term = patch and canary rollout, add claim-length alert.

john_acme: Appreciated — please add a note to the ticket that our automation should skip canary until transformer is fixed (we'll re-enable after confirmation).

lina_cs: Will do. Closing loop once PR merged and we verify no further 403s in your nightly run.
